name: Lori S. Perkins
occupation: Former Uinta County assessor (won the November 2022 general election; the Uinta County Herald reported that she entered retirement on May 30, 2025, after a 34-year career at the Uinta County Complex)
prior_offices: Uinta County assessor (won the November 2022 general election; served until retirement on May 30, 2025, as reported by the Uinta County Herald)
background: Lori S. Perkins served as Uinta County assessor after winning the November 2022 general election. The Uinta County Herald reported on June 25, 2025, that she entered retirement on May 30 after a 34-year career at the Uinta County Complex, and that on June 17, during a county commission meeting, County Attorney Loretta Howieson Kallas swore in Ashlee Richins as the new assessor, replacing her.
